decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line has its own page and fits the firm's core natural facial care range, so a small batch-based producer would keep building on it after two years.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a popular, cheap-to-produce complement to the facial range, and there is no sign of weak performance that would justify withdrawing it.
Cleansing milk is a staple of natural facial routines that sells steadily, and it stays useful even alongside the newer cleansing oil.
The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and extends the core cleansing offer, so the firm would give it time to establish itself.
